svg.aria-label: High level architecture. Sources: 8 CSV files (7 Olist exports and regions.csv). Six layers, no database: Bronze, the files as received; Silver, 8 pandas tables, mapped and typed, 11 asserts; Gold, the rules (sale statuses, late rule, latest review, region); Semantic, 5 CSV files read by Power Query into a star schema of 7 tables, 4 relationships and 5 region roles; Analytical, 23 DAX measures, with sql/checks.sql matching 6 totals; Reporting, 5 pages and 56 visuals, 43 checks. Consume: Power BI Desktop, regional managers and the README.
svg.title: Sales performance architecture

g.text: no database: each layer is a file, a notebook section or part of the report
Python runs it: config.py checks the inputs, analysis.ipynb builds Silver to Semantic and the numbers, theme.py and powerbi/build_pbip.py write the Power BI project
